meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 探索代码时不再直接读整个文件,而是先搜索定位相关文件与函数(带签名、行号),再查看文件结构骨架,最后只展开你要的那个函数或类。
howto.when: 当需要理解代码结构、查找某个函数,或探索整个代码库时,Claude 会接管代码探索,优先用结构化搜索而不是直接读文件。

say.text: 帮我找出项目里所有和 shutdown 相关的函数。
say.note: Claude 会全库搜索并列出带行号的函数。

say.text: 看一下 services/worker-service.ts 的文件结构。
say.note: 返回骨架,不读取文件全部内容。

say.text: 把 worker-service.ts 里的 shutdown 方法展开给我看。
say.note: 只展开该方法的完整源码。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude explores code not by reading whole files, but by searching for relevant files and functions, outlining file structure, then unfolding only the requested symbol's full source.
howto.when_en: When Claude needs to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently, it takes over exploration and prioritizes smart_search/smart_outline/smart_unfold instead of reading files directly.

say_en.text: Find all functions related to shutdown in this project.
say_en.note: Claude searches the whole codebase and lists functions with line numbers.

say_en.text: Show me the file structure of services/worker-service.ts.
say_en.note: Returns the skeleton without reading the entire file.

say_en.text: Expand the shutdown method in worker-service.ts for me.
say_en.note: Only the full source of that method is returned.
